note: Servo upgrade ladder, weakest -> strongest. When a joint is 'servo too weak', step to nextRung for a deterministic torque bump. torqueKgCm = stall torque at the higher of the servo's rated voltages (kg.cm). catalogId matches b123d_server/standard_parts/servos.json where the part exists; null = not yet in catalog (placement should fall back to the nearest catalogued rung).

ladder.name: TowerPro SG90 micro servo
ladder.torqueNote: ~1.8 kg.cm at 4.8-6V; plastic gears, the floor of the ladder

ladder.name: TowerPro SG92R micro servo
ladder.torqueNote: ~2.5 kg.cm at 4.8-6V; carbon-fiber-reinforced plastic gears, same 9g footprint as SG90

ladder.name: TowerPro MG90S micro servo (metal gear)
ladder.torqueNote: ~2.2 kg.cm at 6V; METAL gears — the upgrade over SG90/SG92R is durability/stall-survival, not peak torque. Step here when plastic gears strip, not just for more torque.

ladder.name: TowerPro MG996R standard servo (metal gear)
ladder.torqueNote: ~9.4-11 kg.cm at 4.8-6V; first big torque jump and the first STANDARD-size body — expect a larger mount footprint than the 9g rungs.

ladder.name: DSServo DS3218 standard servo (20kg)
ladder.torqueNote: ~19-21.5 kg.cm at 6.8V (waterproof variant ~20 kg.cm); top of the standard-size ladder. Same standard footprint as MG996R, much higher torque + speed.
